extraction: ECC Skill Create Command: Generate skills from git history analysis. Agent: build. Process: 1) Analyze commits (pattern recognition from history), 2) Extract patterns (common practices/conventions), 3) Generate SKILL.md (structured skill documentation), 4) Create instincts (for continuous-learning-v2). Analysis: git log --oneline -100, commits by file type, most changed files. Patterns: commit message prefixes (feat, fix, refactor), naming conventions, co-author patterns, file structure conventions, import organization, error handling approaches, review feedback, recurring fix types, quality gates. Output: SKILL.md with examples, anti-patterns, instincts JSON for continuous-learning-v2.
